'''Andren Biel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] who lived during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Biel was an Imperial citizen and he trained as an [[Actor/Legends|actor]] at various schools throughout the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. He later stowed away aboard a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] in order to see [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and he was appalled by what he saw of the Empire, so he enlisted in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Biel served the Alliance as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] and he was dispatched to the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] to monitor Imperial [[Navy/Legends|naval]] movements, using his acting skills to help him survive. However, his cover was blown while he was in [[Prak City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Prakith/Legends|Prakith]], and he went into hiding in the nearby [[Asonel Caves]].
